'''Peele Noonal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she gave [[Birthday/Legends|birth]] to a [[Youngling/Legends|child]].
